title: Graduate Engineer - Remedial
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
How many years experience in Structural Design do you have?
Have you worked in a role where you were responsible for authoring and reviewing technical documentation?
apply_instructions: Apply on SEEK (advert 95192751). Agency also lists mike@daviesrossconsulting.com.au; do not treat recruiter mail as employer contact.
rationale: Graduate Civil Engineer role explicitly encourages recent graduates; Bachelor of Civil Engineering matches Marc BSCE.
Duties include site inspections, defect assessments, technical reports and coordinating with engineers, which overlap his Philippines field and project-in-charge work and drawing review.
Structural and remedial focus is adjacent to his structural subjects and Revit footing and bridge coursework, though not road or drainage design.
caution: Davies Ross is a recruitment agency for an unnamed Pyrmont remedial consultancy. Ideally 1 to 2 years postgraduate structural experience is preferred. Sydney relocation from Melton.
gaps: No paid remedial or façade experience
Limited structural design practice beyond study
employer_line: Advert describes a Pyrmont remedial, façade and structural rehabilitation consultancy with building projects typically from about 2 million to 15 million dollars.
